name: MOSS_SFX_acceptance
pipeline: comfyui-moss-soundeffect-v2 community node (HuizhiXu) over MOSS-SoundEffect-v2.0 (OpenMOSS, Apache-2.0)

perf.unload: Unload node kills worker after graph, frees ~11GB (verified: 0 worker procs, VRAM back)

notes: worker zombie on graph error: Unload node is downstream and skipped on failure -> restart server to clear stale worker (pre-triton worker caused repeated TritonMissing)
server MUST start via start_comfy.ps1: PYTHONUTF8=1 required, else worker stderr pump thread dies on GBK -> pipe fills -> deadlock
torchaudio not needed: worker returns npy; pipeline's torchaudio import is lazy inside save_audio() which ComfyUI path never calls
SFX model choice rationale: MMAudio A/B winner but weights CC-BY-NC (no commercial); SA Open CC-BY-NC; SA3 Medium gated. MOSS = Apache-2.0 clean.
